name: codex-hud-desktop
description: Codex HUD dashboard for the ChatGPT desktop app.

interface.shortDescription: Show live Codex session telemetry in the ChatGPT desktop app.
interface.longDescription: Codex HUD Desktop adds a read-only MCP Apps dashboard for local Codex sessions in the ChatGPT desktop app. It is independent from the Codex CLI HUD plugin.
defaultPrompt: Open Codex HUD Desktop for the current session.
Show my current Codex session telemetry in the desktop app.
